budgetProposalActivities.purpose: Empower schools to undertake structured annual self-audits across teaching quality, student welfare, and resource optimization.
budgetProposalActivities.justification: Required under National Education Policy framework 2025-2030 to establish transparent, data-driven school accountability.

budgetProposalActivities.purpose: Standardize lesson observation scoring reliability across all 9 provinces to ensure zero inter-rater variance.
budgetProposalActivities.justification: Field audits identified inconsistency in provincial rating rubrics; standardization will restore national parity.
budgetProposalActivities.expectedOutputs: 180 PQDOs certified in standardized clinical classroom observation.
budgetProposalActivities.keyDeliverables: Certified Evaluator Cadre, Clinical Observation Manual, Provincial Progress Dashboards.
budgetProposalActivities.targetBeneficiaries: Provincial & Zonal Quality Development Officers, In-Service Advisors

columns.label: Outcome / Output No
columns.description: Strategic Outcome or Output numbering reference (e.g. 1.1, 2.3)

columns.label: Activity No
columns.description: Sequential activity code identifier (e.g. 1.1.1, ACT-01)

columns.label: Main Activities
columns.description: Full narrative title and operational description of the implementation activity

columns.label: Vote Number
columns.description: Treasury budgetary vote head from Government Estimates (e.g. 126, 127)

columns.label: Allocation / Estimated Cost (Mn)
columns.description: Total approved budget allocation in Sri Lankan Rupees (Millions LKR)

columns.label: Remark
columns.description: Operational notes, procurement conditions, or executing remarks

columns.label: Indicator
columns.description: Performance measurement metric or deliverable indicator

columns.label: Responsibility
columns.description: Designated implementing officer or desk officer designation
